verdict.rationale: Quo documents its own number provisioning: local and toll-free numbers per user, plus Canadian local and toll-free virtual numbers. That partly covers getting numbers where customers call, but only the US/Canada footprint is evidenced. Nothing states per-country documentation or regulatory requirements up front. missing for 10: international coverage beyond US/Canada, per-country documentation/regulatory requirements stated up front, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a support leader, I can get numbers in the countries my customers call, with each country's documentation requirements stated up front

citations.quote: Canadian local and toll-free virtual numbers from anywhere, with unlimited calls and texts to the US and Canada.
One new or ported phone number (local or toll-free) per user
Set up a business number in minutes
